# opnsense_acmeclient_action (Resource)

ACME automations (**Services ▸ ACME Client ▸ Automations**, plugin `os-acme-client`): commands run after a certificate is issued or renewed, e.g. restart the web GUI or upload the certificate over SFTP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_acmeclient_action" "gui" {
  name = "restart web GUI"
  type = "configd_restart_gui"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to identify this automation.
- `type` (String) Pre-defined commands for this automation. One of `configd_restart_gui`, `configd_restart_haproxy`, `configd_restart_nginx`, `configd_reload_caddy`, `configd_upload_sftp`, `configd_remote_ssh`, `acme_fritzbox`, `acme_panos`, `acme_proxmoxbs`, `acme_proxmoxve`, `acme_ruckus`, `acme_vault`, `acme_synology_dsm`, `acme_truenas`, `acme_truenas_ws`, `acme_truenas_websocat`, `acme_zyxel_gs1900`, `acme_unifi`, `acme_jetkvm`, `configd_generic`.

### Optional

- `acme_fritzbox_password` (String, Sensitive) Password. Defaults to ``.
- `acme_fritzbox_url` (String) URL of the router, i.e. https://fritzbox.example.com. Defaults to ``.
- `acme_fritzbox_username` (String) Username. Defaults to ``.
- `acme_jetkvm_host` (String) IP address or hostname of the JetKVM device. Required first: the device must already have "HTTPS Mode" set to "Custom" in its own web UI (Settings > Network) -- this automation only writes the certificate/key files (and optionally reboots); it does not switch HTTPS mode for you, and the deploy will fail if it isn't already set (check the ACME Client log for the exact reason). Also requires SSH access to already work non-interactively as the configured user (JetKVM only supports key-based SSH authentication -- enable "Developer Mode" on the device and paste this firewall's SSH public key, e.g. from /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub, into its "SSH Keys" field under Settings > Advanced). Leaving this blank does not fail validation -- it falls back to the certificate's own domain name, which is almost never the device's address, so set it explicitly. Defaults to ``.
- `acme_jetkvm_port` (Number) SSH server port on the JetKVM device. Defaults to "22". Defaults to `22`.
- `acme_jetkvm_reboot` (Boolean) JetKVM does not hot-reload a new "Custom" certificate -- a full device reboot is required to apply it, which briefly drops any active KVM-over-IP session. If checked (default), the device is rebooted automatically right after the certificate is uploaded, so an unattended renewal actually takes effect. Uncheck to upload only and apply/verify manually instead. Defaults to `true`.
- `acme_jetkvm_user` (String) The username to login to the JetKVM device via SSH. JetKVM only supports the "root" account for SSH access. Defaults to "root". Defaults to `root`.
- `acme_panos_host` (String) Host. Defaults to ``.
- `acme_panos_password` (String, Sensitive) Password. Defaults to ``.
- `acme_panos_username` (String) Username. Defaults to ``.
- `acme_proxmoxbs_nodename` (String) acme_proxmoxbs_nodename. Defaults to `localhost`.

- `acme_proxmoxbs_user` (String) The user who owns the API key. Defaults to root. Defaults to `root`.

- `acme_vault_token` (String, Sensitive) This specifies the Vault token to authenticate with. Defaults to ``.

- `sftp_filename_cert` (String) Name template for the public certificate. Placeholders "{{name}}" and "%s" are replaced by the name of the certificate being uploaded. Leave blank to use default "{{name}}/cert.pem". Defaults to ``.
